title: Create .env.example and typed config loader
description:
Create .env.example and chatbot/config.py with a pydantic-settings typed config loader.

Before editing, inspect:
- AGENTS.md
- docs/plans_tasks.md
- pyproject.toml (for pydantic-settings dependency)
- docker-compose.yml (for service names, ports, and env var names)

Do not infer APIs, constructor signatures, function names, module locations, or service topology from the task description alone. Inspect the referenced documents and existing implementation files first, then implement against the actual repository.

.env.example:
- DATABASE_URL=postgresql://chatbot:chatbot@localhost:5432/chatbot
- REDIS_URL=redis://localhost:6379/0
- API_HOST=0.0.0.0
- API_PORT=8000
- LOG_LEVEL=INFO
- ENVIRONMENT=development

chatbot/config.py:
- Use pydantic-settings BaseSettings
- Define Settings class with fields: database_url (PostgresDsn or str), redis_url (RedisDsn or str), api_host, api_port (int), log_level, environment
- model_config with env_file=".env", env_file_encoding="utf-8"
- Module-level get_settings() function returning a cached Settings instance (use lru_cache or simple singleton)
- No business logic, no database connections, no Redis client creation

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths. Do NOT modify any other file under any circumstance. Do NOT update documentation, READMEs, operations guides, or any code outside the listed paths. If you believe other files need updating, ignore that impulse and finish the task with only the listed files modified. Out-of-scope edits will cause the task to be rejected.
acceptance_criteria: .env.example exists with DATABASE_URL, REDIS_URL, API_HOST, API_PORT, LOG_LEVEL, ENVIRONMENT
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: modify any file other than .env.example and chatbot/config.py
create database connections or Redis clients in config.py
add env vars to .env.example not listed in the task description
